MARCAR TODAS LAS QUE DIGA LA PERSONA ENTREVISTADA') and asked only of respondents routed to P.10 (P.9 'Sí' -> P.10; P.9a 'Rectifica, sí ha acudido' -> P.10; P.9a 'Confirma, no ha acudido'/'No recuerda'/N.C. -> P.16). In DA2986 every P11xx is '0' ('No procede') for exactly the 591 respondents not so routed (P9=2 & P9A=2 554, P9A=8 27, P9A=9 6, P9=8 & P9A=2 4; 0 exceptions: 0 of the 1893 routed respondents -- P9=1 1646, P9A=1 247 -- carry a 0 on any item, and none of the 591 carries a 1 anywhere in P1101-P1117) and, for the 1893 routed respondents, '1' when the purpose was mentioned and BLANK when not (blank bytes per column p1101..p1111: 1707/1422/1691/1784/1435/1511/1822/1888/1853/1786/1689; every routed respondent has at least one mention across P1101-P1117, 0 all-blank, consistent with blank = not mentioned). Stata infix reads blank as missing and the .do does no recode, so in the live table resp 0 = not asked, resp 1 = mentioned, and the real negative answer (asked, did not mention) is NA and carries no option row; 0 is declared a value label but NOT listed in ES2986's MISSING VALUES for P1101..P1111 (as for P2101..P2110). Per-id zero count in live is 0 (1893 ids) or 11 (591 ids), nothing else. Within the eleven IRW items, 68 of the 1893 routed respondents are NA on all eleven (their mentions are in P1114-P1117, which are not in the table). Suggested data fix in Bookmark 5: among routed respondents recode missing -> 0 (not mentioned), and set 0 -> missing for the 591 not routed. note: mapping_basis=data_labels: ES3137's VARIABLE LABELS tie each column to its statement -- P25_1 'El estado de ánimo puede influir en el dolor que se siente' ... DERIVATION is core model s3 pattern 1: the .do infixes DA3137 at the ES3137 DATA LIST positions (p25_1..p25_8 = cols 224-231, identical to ES3137) and sets item = the lowercased source variable name, so the codes ARE the CIS names -- Step 5b exempt, no verification row or verify_*.R. CHECKED ANYWAY: reading DA3137 (2464 records) at cols 224-231 and dropping 8/9 as the .do does reproduces the live item x resp table cell for cell, all 32 cells (e.g. p25_1 1083/1150/110/43, p25_2 1360/1003/43/9, p25_4 628/1009/272/156, p25_8 1042/921/341/120). The live counts came from one irw_fetch with the irw cache disabled: the first fetch in table_context.R returned 0 rows and cached an empty 1782-byte parquet under ~/.cache/irw/v1/tables/spain_2016_pain_beliefs (irw_table_sets reported 18582 rows at the same time), so the empty cache file is stale and should be cleared before any gate relies on the cache. text_source=study_materials: item_text and instructions transcribed from cues3137.pdf (pdftotext -layout), line breaks rejoined; instructions is the P.25 stem verbatim (single section, so the stem goes in instructions, section_prompt blank). option_text is the questionnaire's printed column headers 'Muy de acuerdo' / 'Bastante' / 'Poco' / 'Nada de acuerdo'; the ES3137 value labels for 2 and 3 are the longer 'Bastante de acuerdo' / 'Poco de acuerdo', and the stem reads the scale aloud as 'muy de acuerdo, bastante, poco o nada de acuerdo', so the printed header form was kept as administered. translation_source=machine_translation: the four _translated columns were written by IRW; CIS publishes this questionnaire only in Spanish.
